## Problem

Honest check-runs are table stakes; the product still fails when the same agent writes the code, the tests, and the claim. Escaped defects (status-tabs and the interaction-bug group) shrank or mis-leveled the claim. Close can still be forged because close-batch trusts agent-copied check-run fields. The brief in spikes/verification-direction-brief.md proposes witnesses from the spec, frozen oracles, and phase-end gap reports — approach not yet chosen.

## Approach

not yet scoped — discuss in progress (spikes/verification-direction-brief.md)

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase. At minimum: close cannot be forged against made-up check-run ids, and deliver/repair work carries atomic requirement ids whose verify path does not re-summarize the claim in criterion prose — verified by close-batch store tests and skill/contract consistency tests.
